title: NRO founded for reconnaissance in denied airspace

tellings.quote: The NRO was founded to get American intelligence in denied airspaces because we knew that nuclear war with the Soviets would lead to mutually assured destruction.

plain: The NRO, the National Reconnaissance Office that runs America's spy satellites, was set up to gather intelligence over 'denied airspace', meaning territory such as the Soviet Union that American planes could not openly fly over. That is how a researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb puts it to Michels, without naming a source. He says the reason was that a nuclear war with the Soviets would mean mutually assured destruction, so the US had to see what the other side was doing.
